customer_segment: Millennials and Gen Z consumers who want convenient portable hydration and are attracted to unconventional branding and sustainability narratives (E6, E4, E8, E9)
end_activity: Consume portable hydration in the moment and feel the choice aligns with personal identity/values, then decide whether to repeat the purchase (E9, E4, E8, E3)

activities.activity: Notice a need for convenient, portable hydration
activities.customer_goal: Quench thirst / stay hydrated with minimal effort while on-the-go or during daily routines

activities.activity: Set selection criteria (e.g., health orientation, environmental concern, and brand/persona fit) and decide to use packaged water versus other hydration options
activities.current_provider: self (influenced by incumbents’ bottled-water options and alternative-to-plastic positioning)
activities.customer_goal: Choose a hydration approach that fits functional needs and personal preferences (including eco concerns and identity signaling)

activities.activity: Discover and evaluate specific packaged-water brands (compare “commodity water” options vs. provocative/viral brands with sustainability narratives)
activities.current_provider: Liquid Death brand/website plus other packaged-water brands’ marketing and brand touchpoints
activities.customer_goal: Reduce uncertainty and pick a brand that feels worth choosing despite category commoditization

activities.activity: Purchase/obtain the chosen packaged-water product from a seller (online or offline)
activities.current_provider: sellers of packaged beverages (channels not specified); Liquid Death is one selectable brand option
activities.customer_goal: Get the product conveniently at an acceptable total cost (price + time/effort)

activities.activity: Consume the product and (optionally) express affiliation by sharing or talking about the brand
activities.current_provider: self (consumption); Liquid Death’s brand experience if selected
activities.customer_goal: Achieve hydration while also getting identity/entertainment value from the brand choice

activities.activity: Dispose/recycle the packaging and decide whether to repurchase, switch, or recommend
activities.current_provider: self + local waste/recycling systems; brand sustainability narrative influences decision
activities.customer_goal: Minimize guilt/friction from packaging waste and decide on repeat behavior
